root_cause.text: The `rockchip_usb2phy_probe` function incorrectly jumps to an error-cleanup label that calls `of_node_put()` on a child device node whose reference has already been released by the `for_each_available_child_of_node` loop.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that when `devm_request_threaded_irq()` fails, the error path is modified to directly `return ret;` instead of executing `goto put_child;`, which would have triggered a duplicate `of_node_put(child_np)` call. This is supported by the commit message: "After breaking from the loop with the child_np has been released, the code will jump to the put_child label and will call the of_node_put() again if the devm_request_threaded_irq() fails."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the error return path in rockchip_usb2phy_probe by returning the error code directly instead of jumping to an incorrect cleanup label.
intent_record.what: Replaced the 'goto put_child;' statement with a direct 'return ret;' in the error handling block of the IRQ request failure.
intent_record.how: This prevents the execution of the cleanup code at the 'put_child' label, ensuring the function exits immediately with the error code when the IRQ request fails.
